Aquatic Dashboard (Maritime)\\n*   **Hull Stress Visualizer**: Real-time sensors showing structural integrity against wave force.\\n*   **Port Berth Queue Analytics**: Live docking status and predicted \\\"Turnaround Time.\\\"\\n*   **Ocean Current Mapping**: Visual current vectors for optimizing fuel efficiency.\\n*   **Submersible Tracking**: A secondary depth-view for underwater assets.\\n\\n#### 5. IT Control Center (Infrastructure)\\n*   **Live Packet Inspector**: A scrolling hex-stream of \\\"Encrypted Data Packets.\\\"\\n*   **Access Matrix Logs**: A grid visualizer showing blocked unauthorized entry attempts.\\n*   **Network Mesh Map**: A physical node layout of the T.H.E.L.M.A. mesh hardware.\\n*   **Cyber-Range Sandbox**: A simulated \\\"Attack/Defend\\\" monitor for firewall testing.\\n\\n#### 7. have successfully deployed **Phase 5: Emergency Response \u0026 Tier-1 Dispatch Intelligence**.\\n\\n### Update Highlights:\\n1.  **Version Bump (v1.3.5)**: All system modules are now running on the Phase 5 core, with the GitHub Sync hash showing `PH5` prefixes for full audit traceability.\\n2.  **Tier-1 Dispatch Matrix**: The Emergency Dashboard now features a high-density incident command viewport. Onboarding Intelligence layer.\\n\\n**(i) Updates Made:**\\n1.  **System Version Bump**: Advanced to **v1.3.6**.\\n2.  **Phase 6 Boot Sequence**: The initialization protocol now verifies the \\\"Human-Agent Handshake\\\" and \\\"Clearance Level Hierarchy.\\\"\\n3.  **Team Setup Overhaul (RBAC)**:\\n    *   **Clearance Scale**: Added a vertical \\\"L1-L10\\\" hierarchy visualizer.\\n    *   **Access Control Matrix**: A new panel mapping roles to specific module permissions (Read, Write, Execute).\\n    *   **L.I.L.Y. Recruitment Intel**: A simulated AI evaluation panel that tracks \\\"Cognitive Gaps\\\" in the current team structure.\\n4.  **GitHub Commit Refresh**: The sync monitor now pushes `PH6-` prefixed hashes to the enterprise mesh.\\n\\n**(ii) Behavior:**\\n- **Access Visualization**: Selecting a team member dynamically highlights their position on the 10-level clearance scale.\\n- **Intelligence Handover**: L.I.L.Y. now proactively flags \\\"Certification Deficits\\\" (e.g., if there aren\u0027t enough L5-certified pilots for the current fleet size).\\n- **Persistent Audio Feedback**: The \\\"Mesh synchronization complete\\\" audio feedback remains active on every auto-save event.\\n\\n**(iii) Visual Appearance:**\\n- **Pure Flat UI**: Adhering to the \\\"no gradients\\\" directive, the new panels use solid `slate-900` backgrounds with `blue-600` and `emerald-500` accents.\\n- **Hierarchy Scale**: A sleek, minimal vertical line with segmented blocks representing the 10 tiers of T.H.E.L.M.A. clearance.\\n\\n\",\"cMarkNode\":{}},\"createdTimestamp\":{\"seconds\":1768271566,\"nanos\":783000000},\"doneTimestamp\":{\"seconds\":1768271566,\"nanos\":784000000}},{\"id\":69,\"author\":\"model\",\"payload\":{\"type\":\"generationTable\",\"entries\":[{\"path\":\"App.tsx\",\"generationType\":1,\"isDone\":true,\"description\":\"Bumped version to v1.3.6. constructor(props: Props) {\\n    super(props);\\n    this.state \u003d {\\n      hasError: false,\\n      error: null,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {\\n boolean;\\n  error: Error | null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Tactical Error Boundary for module isolation.\\n */\\nexport class TacticalErrorBoundary extends React.Component\u003cProps, State\u003e {\\n  public state: State \u003d {\\n    hasError: false,\\n    error: null,\\n  };\\n\\n  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {\\n    return { hasError: true, error };\\n  }\\n\\n  // caught error to determine whether to render children or a fallback UI.\\n    if (this.state.hasError) {\\n      // Returning the fallback prop if provided, or the default tactical fault interface.\\n }\\n}\\n\\n// HOC for wrapping components with the TacticalErrorBoundary.\\nexport const withErrorBoundary \u003d (WrappedComponent: React.ComponentType\u003cany\u003e, moduleName: string)
